1. **`memopayload.Runner`** — `func (r *Runner) RunOnce(ctx context.Context)` at `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27`. It is never invoked anywhere in the codebase — there's no `NewRunner(...)` call or `.RunOnce()` reference for this type outside its own declaration; the only production usage of the `memopayload` package is the free function `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` (called from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`), not the `Runner.RunOnce` method.
   - declarer: `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` — invoked? **no** (no caller found; `Runner` is constructed nowhere in the repo)

2. **`s3presign.Runner`** — `func (r *Runner) RunOnce(ctx context.Context)` at `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43`. It is invoked from production code in two places:
   - internally, from its own `Run` loop's ticker case: `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36`
   - from server startup: `server/server.go:163` (`s3presignRunner.RunOnce(ctx)` inside `startBackgroundRunners`)

Summary:

- `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` (server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27) — invoked? no — no caller (Runner type appears unused; only `RebuildMemoPayload` is called elsewhere)
- `s3presign.Runner.RunOnce` (server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43) — invoked? yes — callers: `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36` (its own `Run` method) and `server/server.go:163` (`Server.startBackgroundRunners`)

No test files reference `RunOnce` at all (searched all `*_test.go`), so all invocation is from production code only.
